company.name: Lyra Health
company.shortDescription: Lyra helps companies improve access to effective mental health care for their employees.
company.description:
Lyra helps companies improve access to effective, high-quality mental health care for their employees.

Lyra's matching technology and innovative digital platform connect members to a curated network of top therapists and coaches, which results in 3x more people receiving care and 7x better outcomes than traditional plans and EAPs. Members can find the right personalized care, match with the right provider for their needs, and feel motivated and supported throughout the entire treatment journey.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series G round raised $57,000,000, or 5.89% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $19,765,055 to $4,562,712,843, a 230.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
